# Tokens

Use tokens and nothing else: no raw colour, size or font in a screen. The values are given here and nowhere else.

**Prefix:** `--ds-`

## Colour

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--ds-color-bg` | `#ffffff` | page background |
| `--ds-color-fg` | `#1b1f24` | body text |
| `--ds-color-accent` | `#0b57d0` | the primary action |

## Type

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--ds-font-body` | `system-ui, sans-serif` | body text |
| `--ds-font-size-body` | `1rem` | body text |
| `--ds-font-size-title` | `1.5rem` | headline |

## Spacing

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--ds-space-1` | `4px` | tight gaps |
| `--ds-space-2` | `8px` | default gap |
| `--ds-space-3` | `16px` | section gap |
